name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost) is a hard ban on dropping the key while the door is closed, matching 'don't drop the key while the door is still closed'. key_lost already carries the closed-door condition, so no Precedence or extra Existence is needed, and the rule-only warning is valid for this restriction.

texts: Never lose the key before the door is opened.
